messages:
kevin_support: Hey team, customer (AcmeRetail) reporting high embedding latency and a bunch of dimension mismatch errors after a deploy. They say requests are hitting eu-west but embeddings returned are wrong length. Request id: r-0a1b2c3d.
ashwin_eng: Can you paste the exact API call and error payload?
kevin_support: Copied from customer: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Region: eu-west-1
{
  \"model\": \"text-embedding-3-small\",
  \"input\": [\"product description text\"...]
}
```
Response: 400 EMB_DIM_MISMATCH expected=1536 actual=1535
kevin_support: Also they saw a big spike in 5xx and long tail latencies (~8s) for ~20 minutes. Billing also flagged a usage burst.
lina_sre: Checking routing logs now, pulling trace r-0a1b2c3d.
sre-bot: New trace captured r-0a1b2c3d. Route decision: prefer eu-west-1, fallback us-west-2 due to capacity.
nashwin_eng: Fallback across regions can cause model variant mismatch if quantized variants differ dims. Need to verify model id mapping used in fallback.
jessica_ml: Confirmed: we have two artifact variants: text-embedding-3-small (1536) and text-embedding-3-small-quant (1535) — weird, quantization should preserve dim but a packaging bug slipped.
nashwin_eng: That explains EMB_DIM_MISMATCH when fallback triggered. Why did fallback trigger? Any coldstart/backlog in eu-west?
lina_sre: eu-west had an autoscaler coldstart window 03:10-03:18 UTC. Queue length hit 280, spillover policy allowed cross-region routing after 120s queue threshold.
nina (support note): Customer said they didn't set preferred_region - they expected sticky eu-west.
sam_devex: We should repro and provide a customer workaround: include region hint header X-Prefer-Region: eu-west-1 and disable cross-region fallback for live until we patch.
kevin_support: Customer asking for immediate mitigation and credit for bad embeddings/billing spike. Billing flagged 1,200 requests at high cost.
billing-bot: Billing alert ID b-334: unusual embeddings unit usage + rate of retries.
jessica_ml: Short term fix: push a hotfix to make quant variant dims identical and block cross-region fallback for embeddings models until validated.
nashwin_eng: I'll prepare a canary that pins fallback policy off for embeddings only, and deploy quant artifact fix.
lina_sre: Steps I'm running now: 1) disable cross-region fallback policy for group embeddings in routing table, 2) pre-warm eu-west pool (scale to +2 nodes), 3) purge pending spillover queue.
lina_sre: Logs snippet: 
```
[03:12:05 UTC] route_decision: fallback_allowed=true queue_len=281 avg_kv_latency=1200ms
[03:12:07 UTC] dispatch: region=us-west-2 model_variant=text-embedding-3-small-quant variant_dim=1535
[03:12:07 UTC] error: EMB_DIM_MISMATCH expected=1536 actual=1535 req=r-0a1b2c3d
```
kevin_support: Customer wants repro steps so they can confirm fix. Can we give a minimal curl that reproduces the mismatch (without exposing change)?
sam_devex: Repro curl (internal use): 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <customer_key>\" \
  -H \"X-Region: eu-west-1\" \
  -H \"X-Prefer-Region: eu-west-1\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\",\"input\":[\"a\"]}'
```
Note: If cross-region fallback is enabled and eu-west is cold, request may get routed to us-west and hit quant variant.
jessica_ml: I will tag the offending quant build and rollback the artifact that changed dims. Also adding a unit check in CI to assert embedding dimension invariant.
nashwin_eng: ETA for patch and rollout?
jessica_ml: Hotfix rollout in progress, starting canary in eu-west and us-west in 10m. Full rollout ~40m if canary ok.
lina_sre: I've paused routing fallback and scaled eu-west capacity, queue draining now. Current queue len 12.
kevin_support: Customer accepted temporary region pin and wants credits for the bad embeddings. Please confirm when complete so I can reply.
sre-bot: Deploy canary started by jessica_ml at 03:30 UTC. Canary ID d-998.
jessica_ml: Canary passed basic smoke, dims fixed. Rolling to 3 more shards.
nashwin_eng: After rollout, we'll add a routing policy change: avoid cross-region fallback for embeddings unless model compatibility matrix allows. I'll open a PR.
lina_sre: Postmortem notes for later: spillover_threshold=120s should be revisited, pre-warm heuristics need to consider embedding workload patterns.
kevin_support: Thanks — I'll propose a credit and share repro steps + ETA with AcmeRetail.
sam_devex: Docs update: add note to embeddings troubleshooting about EMB_DIM_MISMATCH, cross-region fallback, and recommended X-Prefer-Region header.
kevin_support: Anything else we need from customer? they asked for request IDs — provided.
jessica_ml: All fixed from model side. Lina, confirm routing change is live?
lina_sre: Confirmed: fallback disabled for embeddings at 03:41 UTC, queue drained, billing anomaly also flagged for credit review.
kevin_support: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
